scoring_justification: The critical densities are properties of the analytic free energy model; the checker recomputes them from the agent’s raw artifact (order parameter curve) and compares against the correct model solution (A₂=0). T1 is feasible.

outputs.description: Order parameter ψ as a function of total density ρ for k=6, u=0.15. The checker will extract the densities where ψ departs from zero and returns to zero, and compare those critical densities to reference values.
Critical densities ρ_c1 and ρ_c2 as functions of interaction weight u for k=6, q=4. The checker will compare the computed values at sampled u against paper-reported references.

output_contract.notes: The task covers only the q=4 case; the free energy expressions for q>=6 are not fully provided in the paper and are omitted.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold critical densities for k=6, q=4 at any u
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Eqs. (11) and (12); the free energy functional and the self-consistency equation for γ_hh. The correct critical densities are obtained by solving A₂(ρ,u)=0 where A₂ is the coefficient of ψ² in the expansion of the free energy around the isotropic point.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The checker implements the free energy function f(ρ_x,ρ_y,u,k) and computes A₂(ρ,u) by finite difference. It scans ρ and locates where A₂ changes sign, yielding ρ_c1 and ρ_c2 for any given u. No external file is needed.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact solutions of the model defined in the paper; they are not arbitrary numbers but the deterministic outcome of the derived equations. The reference solution (solve.sh) produces the same physics and thus yields consistent values within numeric tolerance.
